_purpose: Known-bad fixture for the DRC flow's negative control (issue #2). Fed to `klt draw`, which writes geometry verbatim with no PDK awareness and no rule checking, precisely so a DRC flow can prove it reports failure as well as success. This cell is deliberately NOT design-legal and is never instantiated by any real layout.

_expected_rules.poly.width.1: the 0.10 um-tall poly (66/20) rectangle is below sky130's 0.15 um minimum poly width -- a WIDTH-class violation
_expected_rules.li1.space.1: the two li1 (67/20) rectangles are separated by a 0.10 um gap, below sky130's 0.17 um minimum li1 spacing -- a SPACING-class violation

_why_two_rule_classes: A width violation and a spacing violation exercise two different KLayout check primitives, so a deck/engine regression that silently disables one of them still gets caught by the other. layout/tests/test_drc_negative_control.py asserts these dimensions stay illegal, PDK-free, so an edit that accidentally makes the fixture legal fails in CI rather than silently turning the negative control into a no-op.
